title: APT_02
description:
Complete transformation of a traditional apartment located in São Pedro, reimagined as an open and contemporary living space.

Originally divided into a sequence of small, compartmentalized rooms, the layout was entirely redesigned to create a fluid, generous, and coherent living environment, enhancing spatial continuity and natural light.

The former veranda was integrated as a direct extension of the kitchen, bringing light and depth to the main living area. A freestanding central block was introduced in the living space to optimize storage while structuring circulation and defining the proportions of the interior.

The kitchen was redesigned around a refined material palette, balancing functionality and warmth. One of the existing bedrooms was converted into a suite, and a new bathroom was created to improve comfort and the overall fluidity of use.
